# Installing agent-policies 0.2.0

Generated artifacts live under `dist/`. Each environment takes a different slice; the rules are the same.

## Grok Bot

1. Add `dist/grok-bot/workspace-conventions/` to the shared skill library (the bot installs it; the skill library is served by the app, not a folder you manage).
2. Add one line to each bot's instructions: "Load the workspace-conventions skill at the start of every turn."
3. Review `dist/grok-bot/auto-review-rules.md` and add the rules you accept in the app.
4. Copy `dist/bots/<bot>/AGENTS.md` to `/workspace/bots/<bot>/AGENTS.md`.

## Cursor and Cloud Agents

Copy the Cursor slice into the root of the target repository and commit it. Cloud Agents read `AGENTS.md`, `.cursor/rules/` and `.cursor/environment.json` from the repo they run on.

```bash
cp -r dist/cursor/. /path/to/target-repo/
```

## Grok Build

Copy `dist/grok-build/AGENTS.md` to the project root. Paths are provisional until confirmed.

## External skills

Installed in Cursor, Cloud Agents and Grok Build with the commands below (add `-g` for a global install). For Grok Bots, copy the pinned skill directory into the shared skill library.

### typesafe-ai

Source `typesafe-ai/skills`, path `skills/typesafe-ai`, version `unpinned`.

```bash
npx skills add typesafe-ai/skills --skill typesafe-ai
```

## Verify

```bash
make check
```
